accordion.title: Opening several panels
accordion.description: Open Account and Alerts together. Billing shows how a disabled item behaves in the same group.

accordion.title: Loading panel content
accordion.description: Open a question to load its answer. Choose “Fail the next load” before opening another question, then retry inside the panel.

accordion.title: Expanding all sections
accordion.description: Use the buttons to expand or collapse every step, then open a single step. Both paths update the same list of open items.

alert-dialog.title: Confirming a file deletion
alert-dialog.description: Each row opens the same dialog with a different filename. Keep the file or confirm to remove just that row.

autocomplete.title: Searching a remote catalog
autocomplete.description: Type part of a country name. The latest query wins as you type. Drop the simulated connection to try the error and retry states.

autocomplete.title: Completing a city inline
autocomplete.description: Type “Li” and press Arrow Down to preview a completion in the input. Press Enter to accept it and check the committed value below.

autocomplete.title: Announcing filtered results
autocomplete.description: Click the command field and type “new”. The status reads the filtered count from the combobox context, including when the list is empty.

avatar.title: Showing a project team
avatar.description: Stack the visible members, use initials when a photo is missing, and show how many other people have access.

avatar.title: Recovering from an image failure
avatar.description: Switch to a broken image to see the delayed initials and the loading status. Restore the source to display the portrait again.

button.title: Keeping focus while saving
button.description: Activate Save draft with the keyboard. The button keeps focus and ignores additional presses until the save finishes.

button.title: Sending a request
button.description: Send a reminder, then drop the simulated network and send another. The pending state prevents duplicate sends. After three seconds, try again and check the confirmed count.

button.title: Giving a custom element button behavior
button.description: Focus Add to reading list and press Enter or Space. Lock the list to disable the custom action and remove it from the tab order.

calendar.title: Choosing a pickup day
calendar.description: Navigate the next eight weeks of pickup dates. Weekends and the first of each month are unavailable.

calendar.title: Selecting a stay across months
calendar.description: Choose the first and last nights in the two-month calendar. The output shows both endpoints.

calendar.title: Jumping to a month and year
calendar.description: Use the month and year selects to find a birthday without stepping through each intervening month.

calendar.title: Closing a calendar after selection
calendar.description: Open the popover with the keyboard and choose a day. The trigger displays the chosen date and the popup closes.

checkbox-group.title: Selecting all notifications
checkbox-group.description: The parent checkbox summarizes the group. Select individual channels to see its mixed state, or select them all at once.

checkbox.title: Saving a subscription
checkbox.description: Toggle the weekly digest while the connection is down. An optimistic check appears immediately and rolls back if the save fails.

checkbox.title: Changing a checkbox from another control
checkbox.description: Toggle the subscription from either control. Both the checkbox and its text summary follow the same value.

checkbox.title: Mixed, read-only and disabled boxes
checkbox.description: Activate the mixed checkbox to resolve it, then restore its mixed state. Compare its keyboard behavior with the read-only and disabled boxes.

collapsible.title: Closing from inside the panel
collapsible.description: Open Advanced options, edit the settings, then choose Done. The trigger and the action inside the panel share one open state.

combobox.title: Searching for a country
combobox.description: Type to search the simulated server and select a result. Drop the connection before typing to try the retry action.

combobox.title: Selecting labels as chips
combobox.description: Add several labels from the suggestions, then remove one using its chip. The list and chips share the selection.

combobox.title: Filtering grouped options
combobox.description: Search across fruit and vegetable groups. Try “leek” to narrow the list to one group, then try a term with no matches.

context-menu.title: Toggling a view option
context-menu.description: Open the menu by pointer or keyboard. Its checkbox controls whether the file list includes hidden files.

date-field.title: Editing localized dates
date-field.description: Edit the same date in different locales. The segment order, separators and numerals follow each locale.

date-field.title: Submitting a bounded date
date-field.description: Enter a check-in date within the next year and book it. The field stays read-only while the request is pending. Drop the simulated connection to try a failed save and retry.

date-field.title: Using the browser’s date picker
date-field.description: Use a styled date input when the browser can supply the picker, locale and segment order.

date-picker.title: Restricting collection dates
date-picker.description: Choose a weekday between tomorrow and eight weeks from today. The field and the calendar share the booking restrictions.

date-picker.title: Setting a date from outside the picker
date-picker.description: Choose “In a week”, clear the date, or open the calendar from a second button. The field reflects each change.

date-picker.title: Validating a renewal date
date-picker.description: Book a renewal between today and one year from now. Field validation and form submission use the same date.

date-range-picker.title: Applying report presets
date-range-picker.description: Select a preset to update both ends of the range, then fine-tune the dates in the calendar.

date-range-picker.title: Blocking a range across booked nights
date-range-picker.description: Pick dates within the next six months. Try a stay that crosses the tenth or twentieth of a month to see how unavailable nights constrain the range.

date-range-picker.title: Submitting both ends of a trip
date-range-picker.description: Submit an incomplete range to see the error, then choose both endpoints. A named field returns the trip’s start and end dates together.

dialog.title: Saving an edit to the server
dialog.description: Make the next save fail, then rename the project. The dialog keeps your draft so you can retry and closes once the save succeeds.

dialog.title: Keeping an editor usable
dialog.description: Open the shortcut reference and return to the draft. You can keep typing while the reference stays open.

drawer.title: A swipeable shopping cart
drawer.description: Open the cart at the right edge. Swipe right to dismiss it, or use the Close button.

field.title: Matching validation messages
field.description: Enter a partial verification code, then clear it. The field chooses a message for the specific validity error.

field.title: Validating a plain HTML form
field.description: Try a reserved handle or an invalid character. The field’s custom rule and the native input constraints both participate in form submission.

field.title: Checking a reserved username
field.description: Type “admin” or “root” to see a custom error, then choose a name of at least three characters to clear it.

field.title: Reading validity in a custom status
field.description: Enter a URL. A child of FieldValidity reads the field’s validation state and displays the message alongside the input.

fieldset.title: Reusing a billing address
fieldset.description: Clear “Ship to the billing address” to enable the shipping fields together.

file-upload.title: Tracking individual uploads
file-upload.description: Choose several files and follow each upload separately. The simulated endpoint rejects files over 2 MB halfway through.

file-upload.title: Using the native file chooser
file-upload.description: Choose a document through the visible file input. Its name, size and remove action follow the selection.

file-upload.title: Submitting receipts with a form
file-upload.description: Submit the claim empty, then attach a photo or PDF. The form receives the selected files under the receipts field.

form.title: Validating on blur
form.description: Leave the email field with an incomplete address to see its validation message. Correct it and submit the form.

form.title: Reopening a form with server errors
form.description: Edit the handle to dismiss the initial error and save a different name. Reset restores the original input and clears validation.

input.title: Counting characters
input.description: Edit the short bio. Its character count and Clear button read and write the same value.

listbox.title: Choosing notification channels
listbox.description: Select several delivery methods. The summary reflects the number of selected options.

listbox.title: Organizing time zones by region
listbox.description: Move through the list with the arrow keys. Regions label related cities while only the cities can be selected.

listbox.title: Selecting a size with arrow keys
listbox.description: Focus the size selector and use Left and Right. Selection follows focus, wraps at the ends and skips the unavailable size.

menu.title: Opening a recent file
menu.description: Open the menu to load recent files, then choose one. Drop the connection before opening the menu or a file to try either failure.

menu.title: Checkbox and radio menu items
menu.description: Toggle file display options independently. Choose one sort order from the radio group.

menu.title: Opening a nested menu
menu.description: Open Insert, focus Chart and press Right to choose a chart type. Press Left to return to the parent menu.

menubar.title: Changing the editor view
menubar.description: Move between menus with the arrow keys. Use the View menu to change which panels appear in the editor.

meter.title: Reporting storage in gigabytes
meter.description: Format disk usage in gigabytes and supply an accessible value that includes the total capacity.

navigation-menu.title: Loading navigation on demand
navigation-menu.description: Each menu loads its links the first time it opens. Drop the connection before opening a new menu to retry a failed load.

number-field.title: Editing prices and percentages
number-field.description: Edit the localized price or discount. The output beneath each field shows its underlying numeric value.

number-field.title: Saving committed values
number-field.description: Change the seat count with a stepper or by typing and leaving the field. A failed save restores the confirmed count.

otp-field.title: Verifying a sign-in code
otp-field.description: Complete all four digits to start verification. The slots become read-only while checking and clear after an incorrect code.

otp-field.title: Normalizing an alphanumeric key
otp-field.description: Type or paste a five-character recovery key. The slots accept letters and digits and convert letters to uppercase.

pagination.title: Paging through local results
pagination.description: Use the page buttons to change the visible results and keep your place on this documentation page.

popover.title: Loading notifications on open
popover.description: Open the inbox to load its messages. Make the next load fail, reopen the inbox, and retry inside the popover.

popover.title: Opening with hover or a press
popover.description: Rest the pointer on Shipping to preview the delivery terms. The trigger also works with a click or the keyboard.

popover.title: Opening filters from another control
popover.description: Open the filters from either button. Apply the filter to close the popup and watch the shared open state.

preview-card.title: Previewing a documentation link
preview-card.description: Hover or focus the link to preview its destination after a short delay. Follow the link to read the full guide.

progress.title: Reporting an export
progress.description: Use Unknown while the total is unavailable, then report progress in increments until the export finishes.

radio.title: Saving a density preference
radio.description: Change the selected density while a save is pending. A failed request restores the last confirmed choice.

radio.title: Choosing a plan from cards
radio.description: Select a plan by pressing anywhere on its card. The group retains radio-button keyboard navigation.

scroll-area.title: Scrolling a wide grid
scroll-area.description: Scroll across the columns and down the rows. Focus the viewport to explore the grid with the keyboard.

scroll-area.title: Fading the edges of a long list
scroll-area.description: Scroll through the folders. Each edge fades only while more content lies beyond it.

segmented-control.title: Choosing a text size
segmented-control.description: Control the chosen value and show it beside the control. The arrow keys move between the segments and choose as they go.

segmented-control.title: Segments with icons
segmented-control.description: Put an icon beside each label. A disabled segment is skipped by the arrow keys.

select.title: Loading options on first open
select.description: Open the select to request countries. Drop the connection before the first open to try the loading, error and retry states.

select.title: Grouping produce options
select.description: Open the picker to browse related options under their group labels and separators.

select.title: Selecting several toppings
select.description: Choose more than one topping, then select one again to remove it. The trigger summarizes the current selection.

select.title: Clearing a controlled selection
select.description: Choose a size, then clear it from outside the popup. The trigger returns to its placeholder.

separator.title: Separating groups in a menu
separator.description: Use a horizontal separator to distinguish setup guides from component references in the same menu.

separator.title: Building a custom divider
separator.description: Apply the separator props to a div between two groups of controls to expose a vertical separator to assistive technology.

slider.title: Setting a price range
slider.description: Move either thumb in five-dollar steps. The minimum distance keeps the lower and upper prices apart.

slider.title: Saving volume on release
slider.description: Drag to preview a volume, then release to save it. Drop the connection to see the last confirmed volume return.

slider.title: Adjusting a vertical equalizer
slider.description: Adjust the three frequency bands independently with the pointer or arrow keys.

slider.title: Reading live and committed values
slider.description: Drag the brightness thumb and pause before releasing it. The first output follows the drag and the second records the committed value.

sortable.title: Saving a folder order
sortable.description: Drag a folder or reorder it with the keyboard. The list shows the new order immediately and restores it if the request fails.

sortable.title: Moving cards between lists
sortable.description: Move a task from To do to Doing or into the empty Done column. A single group keeps all three lists in sync.

sortable.title: Reordering by the whole item
sortable.description: Drag a tag directly or focus it and press Space to lift it. Move it with Left or Right and press Enter to drop it.

sortable.title: Showing the insertion point
sortable.description: Drag a chapter over another one. A line marks the drop position while the chapters stay in place.

splitter.title: Collapsing a sidebar
splitter.description: Drag the handle past the sidebar’s minimum size, or focus it and press Enter to collapse and expand it.

splitter.title: Resizing nested panels
splitter.description: Resize the outline horizontally, then move the divider between the editor and console vertically. Each handle belongs to its own splitter.

splitter.title: Applying a layout preset
splitter.description: Switch between the two presets, then drag the divider. The readouts distinguish changes during the drag from the final sizes.

splitter.title: Saving a layout on release
splitter.description: Drag the divider and release it to save the proportions. Simulate an outage before resizing to see the failure and try again.

switch.title: Saving an alert preference
switch.description: Flip the switch, then try it with the simulated connection down. The thumb moves immediately and rolls back when the save fails.

switch.title: Labelling related settings
switch.description: Activate the backup switch by its label. Each setting has a description, and the second field disables its switch.

table-of-contents.title: Reporting the current section
table-of-contents.description: Scroll the article or follow one of its links. The reading label follows the active section in this scroll container.

tabs.title: Loading the selected panel
tabs.description: Switch tabs while an answer is loading. Only the selected tab’s answer appears. Fail the next load to try the inline retry.

tabs.title: Animating panel changes
tabs.description: Switch between reporting periods. The outgoing and incoming panels share a grid cell while they fade.

tabs.title: Navigating vertical tabs
tabs.description: Use Up and Down to browse settings. Each panel opens as its tab receives focus.

tags-input.title: Validating a recipient list
tags-input.description: Enter email addresses separated by spaces. Duplicate entries, invalid addresses and a sixth recipient each get a specific message.

tags-input.title: Submitting and resetting tags
tags-input.description: Try saving an empty ingredient list, then add tags and submit. Reset restores the field to its initial state.

time-field.title: Editing time across locales
time-field.description: Compare second-level precision, a 24-hour clock and localized segments, including right-to-left entry.

time-field.title: Using a native time input
time-field.description: Edit the time with the browser’s own control. The browser chooses the segment layout and input method.

time-picker.title: Choosing an opening-hours slot
time-picker.description: Choose a time within the posted opening hours. The bounds apply to both the field and the popup.

time-picker.title: Picking seconds on a 24-hour clock
time-picker.description: Set a lap time using hours, minutes and five-second increments.

time-picker.title: Picking from appointment slots
time-picker.description: Choose a half-hour slot between opening and closing time from a single list.

time-picker.title: Submitting an arrival time
time-picker.description: Submit before choosing a time to see the required error. Book an arrival from 7 AM onward to see its submitted value.

time-range-picker.title: Scheduling a night shift
time-range-picker.description: Set the end time earlier than the start to represent a shift that crosses midnight.

time-range-picker.title: Validating office hours
time-range-picker.description: Submit with a missing time or a closing time before opening. Correct the range to see both submitted values, or reset both fields together.

toast.title: Undoing an archive
toast.description: Archive the conversation, then choose Undo in its notification to return it to the inbox.

toast.title: Following a publish request
toast.description: Publish twice to see both outcomes from the simulated server. A single toast follows each request from pending to success or retry.

toast.title: Sending a toast from outside the provider
toast.description: Trigger a notification from a button outside the provider. The shared manager delivers it to the viewport.

toast.title: Dismissing a top-edge notification
toast.description: Reconnect to show a notification at the top of the page. Swipe up to dismiss it or wait for its timeout.

toggle-group.title: Combining text styles
toggle-group.description: Toggle any combination of styles. The output lists the values selected in the group.

toggle.title: Saving a starred project
toggle.description: Star the project, then change your mind while the save is pending. Drop the connection to see the optimistic change roll back.

toolbar.title: Adjusting document zoom
toolbar.description: Use the toolbar buttons or enter a percentage from 75 to 200 in steps of 25. Reset restores the original scale.

tooltip.title: Explaining an unavailable action
tooltip.description: Focus or hover the export control to see why it is unavailable. The explanation is also visible beside the control.
